item.title: Programmable Logic Controller (PLC)
item.description:
Correction | Procurement | Award | $330K | Vendor: Tomex Electronics Inc

The New York City Department of Correction (NYCDOC) seeks a qualified M/WBE-certified vendor to develop and implement a comprehensive integration of the Departments existing Programmable Logic Controller (PLC)based jail control panels with the Genetec Security Center platform. The project encompasses two independent cell wings, each containing 48 inmate cells and 4 auxiliary rooms (totaling 104 access points across both wings). Each wing operates using its own PLC hardware and wiring infrastructure, which must be integrated into DOCs unified Genetec security ecosystem for centralized command, monitoring, automation, and video-assisted situational awareness. This modernization initiative aims to replace manual, panel-based workflows with automated, rules-driven functionality, enhancing operator efficiency, reducing human error, and improving DOCs ability to escalate, track, and respond to security-critical events in real time
